 return float(predict(x)[0])
cases=[
dict(age_c=.5,wfns45=1,fisher34=1,ct_ivh=1,ct_ich=1,surgery=0,urban=0),
dict(age_c=.5,wfns45=1,fisher34=1,ct_ivh=1,ct_ich=1,surgery=0,urban=1),

for age in [0,1,2,3]:
 for wf in [0,1]:
  ds=[]
  for lab in [0,2,5,8,10]:
   for mask in range(128): # other binaries except wf, farmer
    x=np.zeros((1,11));x[0,0]=age;x[0,2]=wf;x[0,10]=lab
    inds=[1,3,4,5,6,7,8]
    for q,i in enumerate(inds):x[0,i]=(mask>>q)&1
    a=x.copy();a[0,9]=1
    ds.append(float(predict(a)[0]-predict(x)[0]))
  print("age",age,"WFNS",wf,"farmer avg",round(np.mean(ds),3),"median",round(np.median(ds),3),"range",round(min(ds),3),round(max(ds),3))

ds=[]
for age in [0,1,2,3]:
 for lab in [0,2,5,8,10]:
  for mask in range(128):
   x=np.zeros((1,11));x[0,0]=age;x[0,10]=lab
   q=0
   for i in [1,2,3,4,5,6,7]:x[0,i]=(mask>>q)&1;q+=1
   # x comparator urban=1 farmer=0 versus rural farmer urban=0 farmer=1
   a=x.copy();a[0,8]=0;a[0,9]=1
   b=x.copy();b[0,8]=1;b[0,9]=0
   ds.append(float(predict(a)[0]-predict(b)[0]))
print("Rural farmer minus city nonfarmer",np.mean(ds),np.median(ds),min(ds),max(ds))

ds=[]
for age in [0,1,2,3]:
 for lab in [0,2,5,8,10]:
  for mask in range(128):
   x=np.zeros((1,11));x[0,0]=age;x[0,10]=lab
   q=0
   for i in [1,2,3,4,5,6,7]:x[0,i]=(mask>>q)&1;q+=1
   # x comparator urban=1 farmer=0 versus rural farmer urban=0 farmer=1
   a=x.copy();a[0,8]=0;a[0,9]=1
   b=x.copy();b[0,8]=1;b[0,9]=0
   ds.append(float(predict(a)[0]-predict(b)[0]))
print("Rural farmer minus city nonfarmer",np.mean(ds),np.median(ds),min(ds),max(ds))
